title: Toxicokinetics of Two Oxathiapiprolin Enantiomers in Rats and Their Stereoselective Interaction with Oxysterol Binding Protein.
authors: Liang, Xiao; Su, Weiping; Chang, Alan Kueichieh; Zhuang, Chuchu; Pei, Ying; Ai, Jiao; Li, Haoran; Liu, Kai; Li, Jianxin; Fu, Hongfei; Liu, Yuting; Liu, Wenbao; Zhang, Xinzhong
journal: Journal of agricultural and food chemistry
one_liner_zh: 该文研究手性农药恶噻菌灵对映体在大鼠体内的毒代动力学及其与氧甾醇结合蛋白的立体选择性结合，虽涉及分子对接，但核心是农药代谢与毒性评估，非蛋白质-DNA互作体系，与本课题无关。
abstract: Oxathiapiprolin is a chiral fungicide, and it can affect the metabolism of the cholesterol compounds by inhibiting oxysterol binding protein (OSBP) to exert its fungicidal effect. The application of oxathiapiprolin in agriculture is widespread, and its residue in the environment is a threat to both human and animal health. The two oxathiapiprolin enantiomers differ in their fungicidal activity, biotoxicity, and degradation by environmental forces. However, their biotoxicity has not been reported in animals. The toxicokinetics of a pesticide should be a crucial component for the evaluation of its toxicity in vivo. In this study, we investigated the absorption, bioavailability, tissue distribution, and excretion of the two oxathiapiprolin enantiomers in rats to verify their toxicokinetic process in animals. An ultrahigh-performance liquid chromatography triple quadrupole tandem mass spectrometry (UHPLC-QQQ/MS) method was established to quantify the two oxathiapiprolin enantiomers in vivo. The two oxathiapiprolin enantiomers were found to have approximately the same absorption rate and bioavailability, and both were excreted mainly in the feces. The half-life of R-(-)-oxathiapiprolin was nearly twice that of S-(+)-oxathiapiprolin. R-(-)-oxathiapiprolin also had greater distribution than S-(+)-oxathiapiprolin in the liver, lungs, heart, spleen, kidneys, stomach, large intestine, small intestine, brain, and pancreas, supporting the notion that R-(-)-oxathiapiprolin could better bind with OSBP. The stereoselectivity of S-(+)-oxathiapiprolin in these tissues may be responsible for it being readily metabolized in vivo. The molecular docking technique was subsequently used to verify the more superior binding between R-(-)-oxathiapiprolin and OSBP compared with the binding between S-(+)-oxathiapiprolin and OSBP. The findings of this study could provide more reliable data for determining the toxicokinetics of a single enantiomer of oxathiapiprolin in animals, thereby providing some theoretical basis for its subsequent toxicological study.
abstract_zh: Oxathiapiprolin是一种手性杀菌剂，它通过抑制氧固醇结合蛋白（OSBP）来影响胆固醇类化合物的代谢，从而发挥其杀菌作用。Oxathiapiprolin在农业中应用广泛，其在环境中的残留对人类和动物健康构成威胁。Oxathiapiprolin的两种对映体在杀菌活性、生物毒性和环境降解方面存在差异。然而，它们在动物体内的生物毒性尚未有报道。农药的毒代动力学应为其体内毒性评估的关键组成部分。在本研究中，我们考察了两种oxathiapiprolin对映体在大鼠体内的吸收、生物利用度、组织分布和排泄情况，以验证其在动物体内的毒代动力学过程。建立了一种超高效液相色谱三重四极杆串联质谱（UHPLC-QQQ/MS）方法，用于定量检测体内两种oxathiapiprolin对映体。研究发现，两种oxathiapiprolin对映体具有大致相同的吸收速率和生物利用度，且均主要通过粪便排泄。R-(-)-oxathiapiprolin的半衰期几乎是S-(+)-oxathiapiprolin的两倍。R-(-)-oxathiapiprolin在肝脏、肺、心脏、脾脏、肾脏、胃、大肠、小肠、脑和胰腺中的分布也大于S-(+)-oxathiapiprolin，这支持了R-(-)-oxathiapiprolin能更好地与OSBP结合的观点。S-(+)-oxathiapiprolin在这些组织中的立体选择性可能使其易于在体内代谢。随后采用分子对接技术验证了R-(-)-oxathiapiprolin与OSBP的结合优于S-(+)-oxathiapiprolin与OSBP的结合。本研究结果可为确定oxathiapiprolin单一对映体在动物体内的毒代动力学提供更可靠的数据，从而为其后续毒理学研究提供一定的理论基础。
